description: React component SuperNoteMarkdownPreview, which provides a markdown preview modal with copy functionality for a note.

classes.name: SuperNoteMarkdownPreview
classes.description: React functional component rendering a markdown preview modal with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies the markdown text to clipboard and temporarily updates copy state to show 'Copied' message.

methods.name: onMarkdown
methods.description: Updates the component's markdown state when new markdown is generated.
